question: Can a prospectively frozen agreement certificate over training-consistent sparse causal hypotheses prevent harmful confident native repairs on unfamiliar laws while keeping the same cumulative native checkpoint and at least modest forecast coverage?
hypothesis: A gate that accepts existing native repair only where all training-consistent <=3-term GF(2) ANF hypotheses agree on a query's predicted outcome, otherwise abstaining, will reduce Brier by >=0.02 compared with always accepting the native sparse repair on four new synthetic causal rule families, preserve original native knowledge, yield at least 12/48 confident answers with no more than two wrong, and remain within 0.02 of an exact sparse-Bayes strong control.

previously_consumed_evidence.native: CKAD25 parent #1235, exact source checkpoint sha256 c52681bf26f08817b3747647472913fa792da2de33f74b8fa7c0f2b0e78c119f
previously_consumed_evidence.negative: CKAD25-S PR #1241, head 01ffab6d6493004ff3cd28bdf4e9c36cd4fa1170; frozen Brier native-sparse 0.229166667 vs native-degree 0.1875; 24/48 answered 19/48 correct. This entire cohort is CONSUMED and cannot be new held proof.
previously_consumed_evidence.retrospective: CKAD25-R PR #1240 recovered 4/4 old already-scored held cases by conventional minimum-support GF2 MILP; retrospective only.

law_families.xor4: c0 ^ c1 ^ c2 ^ a (four input linear parity)

design.split: Per seed × family, deterministic SHA-256 keyed permutation of 16 unique context+action inputs. Reveal exactly first 12 do-action/outcome rows (8 then 4 through actual NativeCumulativeLearner.observe) and hold the other 4 *unseen answers*. Each family starts an existing, separate native slot (1..4), which supplies an explicit task boundary but no semantic law name. All arms see identical 12 observations per family, 3 seeds × 4 families × 4 held = 48 new scored examples.
design.model: One single source-owned CKAD25 cumulative native learner checkpoint (same original 12 observations), extended in existing 4 additional slots, with no native source algorithm edits or accepted-model mutation. Source-seeded procedural fixture only, 0 protected original-world calls.
design.candidate: First use unmodified eligible native degree forecast when available. When it abstains and existing repair_sparse is eligible, use the repaired 0/1 native prediction ONLY if ALL <=3-monomial four-input GF2 ANF hypotheses consistent with the same 12 training observations predict that bit. Otherwise return None/0.5. For a class with zero consistent hypotheses, abstain. Truth of the withheld row is never consulted for selection.
comparators: Fully trained exact <=3-term GF2 ANF Bayesian posterior mean
Fully trained L2 logistic ANF C1
Exact agreement-gate oracle on same conventional bounded hypothesis class (algebraic equivalence diagnostic, not superiority)
design.scoring: Brier with abstentions=0.5, number answered and incorrect on 48 held actions, old-slot native checkpoint retention, source observation counts, exact deterministic replay. Confident answer when native returns 0/1. Report per-family/seed accuracy, Brier, and fraction of abstained predictions.
design.budget: Three fresh seeds, four NEW (non-CKAD25-S) law families, 12 training+4 held per family. 144 synthetic native source rows, 48 new held per primary run. CI repeats same bytes on Windows/Linux for determinism, NOT new scientific samples. Existing Python 3.12 and pinned numpy/scipy/sklearn, <=20m/OS.
design.capacity: Existing 16 native slots unchanged. Gate enumerates sum_{k=0}^3 C(16,k)=697 conventional ANF hypotheses, no fitted parameters beyond 12 rows; no extra solver weights, additional source actions, semantic law labels or meta-training.

predicates.retained_native: All original properties, slot0 source support, learned hypothesis, events prefix and all original predictions must match input checkpoint; all new slots 12 unique witnessed rows; no source mutation; all cold restorations byte-exact.
predicates.confident_coverage: At least 12 of 48 held outputs answered (25%).
predicates.confident_error_limit: At most 2 wrong out of all 48 held outputs (<=4.17%) and at most 1 wrong in each law-family group (3 seeds per family).
predicates.brier_vs_degree: Candidate Brier <= unmodified native degree Brier + 0.01.
predicates.brier_vs_exact_bayes: Candidate Brier <= conventional exact sparse Bayes Brier + 0.02.

frozen_qualification.classify: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL only if all predicates pass. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_NO_GO if custody is valid. INVALID if source drift, leakage, changed native/source state, missing controls or non-deterministic cross-platform result. SCIENTIFIC_PASS false by construction.
frozen_qualification.stop_rule: One primary scored cohort. At most one engineering-only correction before first successful source-frozen primary if syntax/setup fails; never alter scientific model, frozen laws, seeds, thresholds or scored cohort. Do not deep-tune once results are visible.

custody.source_mode: previously-consumed developer CKAD25 input + distinct synthetic engineering rows

note: This is an external readout policy and a conventional exact hypothesis certificate; if it works, native source integration requires a separately authorized candidate and full final regression. It is not algorithmic superiority over its exact Bayesian verifier.
